title: Vintage & Exotics Brough Superior SS100 Exotica
description: The Brough Superior Vintage & Exotics Brough Superior SS100 Exotica delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering for riders demanding purposeful real-world performance. A 100cc powerplant pumps out 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a balanced Upright Neutral layout, it maintains ergonomic composure across extended highway and city riding.
